chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding the people of the jizyah: is anything taken from their wealth and their livestock besides the jizyah? He said, "No."
ai.seo_question: Can anything besides the jizyah be taken from the wealth and livestock of the people of jizyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning أهلُ الْجِزْيَةِ, stating that nothing is to be taken from their wealth or livestock beyond the jizyah itself. It indicates a limit on financial exaction and clarifies the scope of this tax in Islamic jurisprudence.
